title: Statement Note: The Settlement Record Uplift on a Crop Input Purchasing Account
content:
An account that has been paid down steadily through the season carries an uplift on its volume discount rate, and where some of that money came out of grain the member sold to the cooperative the uplift is the larger of the two.

**Clause.** Where five or more payments stand posted to the account over the 14 statement months before the handling date and at least one of them was made by a transfer of grain settlement proceeds, the settlement record uplift added to the volume discount rate is 0.40 percent. Where five or more payments stand posted to the account over those months and none of them was made by that route, the uplift is 0.20 percent. In every other case no uplift is added on the Crop Input Purchasing Accounts.

### What goes in, and what comes out

- *Payments posted over the 14 statement months:* 6, *of which by a transfer of grain settlement proceeds:* 1 → **uplift 0.40 percent**
- *Payments posted:* 5, *of which by a transfer of grain settlement proceeds:* none → **uplift 0.20 percent**
- *Payments posted:* 4, *of which by a transfer of grain settlement proceeds:* 2 → **no uplift is added**, the count of payments not having reached five

The count is of payments standing posted to that crop input account inside the window, of any route the programme allows; the route matters only in deciding which of the two uplifts is reached once five payments stand posted.
